_comment: Words a word-bank chip keeps capitalized in the middle of a sentence. Every other Title Case word is lowercased there ("Balanced Force" -> "balanced force"); all-caps words, single letters and words with digits are always left alone. Add a name here when one shows up lowercased, then run tools/scrape_keyterms.py. A possessive matches its name: "Kepler" covers "Kepler's".
